# Fixture provenance

`official-records.sie` contains short public format-record examples from the
SIE-Gruppen specification edition 4B (sections 8 and #FORMAT/#SIETYP), with a
type declaration. This limited excerpt is fewer than 25 words; no customer
data or proprietary chart was copied. It is not an official certification
test file. Source:
https://sie.se/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/SIE_filformat_ver_4B_ENGLISH.pdf

Complete transaction fixtures in `correctness.test.mjs` and the PostgreSQL
suite are original synthetic fixtures. An independent external SIE validator
has NOT been executed; internal roundtrip is not independent validation.
